title: Berossus Dynasty 7: second Assyrian dynasty of Babylon
summary: The seventh dynasty of Berossus: Assyrian kings and kingless years at Babylon from Sargon II's death to Nabopolassar.
description: CFAH-5 anchor point AP-44. Added by the CFAH pass.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 5: The Babylonian Dynasties of Berossus," ARJ 16 (2023): 635–670, section "AP-44: Dynasty 7: Second Assyrian Dynasty of Babylon: 705–626 B.C."
chronologies.note: The text of the section counts the 80 years from 706 B.C. (Berossus's date for the end of Dynasty 6) to 626 B.C.; the kings are filled in from Ptolemy's Royal Canon.
